name: What is the average cost to repair a leaking toilet tank?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost to repair a leaking toilet tank?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to repair a leaking toilet tank varies based on the cause and extent of the damage. Simple fixes, like replacing a flapper or fill valve, might range from $75 to $200 for parts and labor. More complex issues, such as replacing tank-to-bowl gaskets or addressing a cracked tank (which usually requires a full toilet replacement), will be more expensive. Factors like the plumber's hourly rate and the need for emergency service can also influence the total cost. It's always advisable to get a quote after a diagnostic assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair costs vary, typically $75-$200 for minor fixes like flapper or fill valve replacement. More complex issues or a cracked tank will incur higher costs.
